name: gate_closed
description: 12 genes x 27 samples, 15 vs 12, nperms = 300. Gene 1 is planted strongly up so its exceedance count is 0, but B < 2*n_tail = 500 so NO gene is refined and the minimum p-value is 1/301. Tests the refinement gate's B condition.
notes: refined_diff_i0 and refined_tail_i0 must both be empty.
